exposure: gestational age at Cesarean delivery (term vs preterm)
cohort: A total of 211 pregnant women undergoing Cesarean section were included, divided into term or preterm groups based on gestational age.
finding: Women undergoing preterm Cesarean section experienced significantly greater blood loss and a larger fall in post-operative hemoglobin levels compared to those undergoing term Cesarean section.
cross-section timing: During Cesarean section and immediately post-operatively
gest_age: Preterm vs Term (defined as 37 completed weeks or more) at the time of Cesarean delivery
